exact_target.required_output: A compiling Lean theorem family which transports pointwise Hermite lower/upper bounds for p=5 and p=6 through actual probability-measure integrals with finite third/fourth/p-th moments, and proves equality for explicitly defined two-Dirac probability measures when their moments and pointwise contact assumptions hold.
minimum_interfaces: generic lower/upper integral transport using MeasureTheory.Measure ℝ and the real integral
a named actual two-node measure constructed from Measure.dirac and weights in [0,1]
an attainment theorem whose equality conclusion uses its stated moment/contact hypotheses
specialization or named wrappers for p=5 and p=6
forbidden_shortcuts: sorry, admit, opaque axiom, or unproved postulate
replacing the measure statement by a finite-vector expectation only
claiming C04 relative-minimax application or global optimum
silently substituting endpoint/Dirac degeneracies into strict C02 0/0 node formulas

accepted_lemma_signatures: C03 supplies pointwise lower/upper Hermite contacts and the affine moment value c0 + c3*m3 + c4*m4 for p=5,6; this successor may take those facts as explicit hypotheses but must prove the measure-theoretic transport.

C02 supplies strict-interior two-node feasibility and positive weights; this successor may take weights/moment identities/contact as explicit hypotheses but must define the corresponding actual measure before asserting attainment.
C04 is not an input theorem here: its historical acceptance record lacks the required scoped independent review, so no minimax conclusion may be used.
